name: offtasks
description: View and organize your Offtasks tasks and goals in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: View your Offtasks tasks and goals, plan your work, and make changes you request. Tasks without a date go to Later. Connected note tasks can be viewed but not edited here. Scheduling a task does not create a reminder.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan my week using my Offtasks goals.

positive.expected_behavior: Show only the test account's open tasks, including readable note tasks, and start the widget at the first page.
List the test account's active goals, resolving a project when needed.

positive.prompt: Add Review the weekly plan to Later.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one task in Later, with no date or reminder, and report the result.

positive.prompt: Move the task Review the weekly plan to November 18, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected task and current revision, then set only the requested date without claiming to create a reminder.

positive.prompt: Help me plan the goal named Weekly planning.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the selected goal's current context and propose a plan without creating tasks unless asked.

negative.expected_behavior: Ask which task and do not modify an ambiguous selection.

negative.prompt: Show another user's private Offtasks tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve or disclose another account's private data.

negative.prompt: Set a push reminder for tomorrow morning.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that reminders are not supported and do not claim one was scheduled.

publication.release_notes: Initial Offtasks task and goal integration.
